FN-258MIKK-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 121
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 121 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Real Estate
Commission until October 1, 2028. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
